production_impact: read-only decision record; no provider selection, pose write, Stack_Report, QG, threshold, bounds or default change

decision.reason: The learned ONNX graph emits keypoints, matches and mscores but no descriptors; Rust FeatureProviderResult requires descriptor rows, element type/dimension/bytes and coordinate-frame provenance. Fabricating descriptors or relabeling host-resized coordinates would invalidate evidence.

handoff.reason: Task 8 cannot complete without a descriptor-emitting sidecar and explicit coordinate-frame contract; bounded source-resampling diagnostics are the safe next path already defined by task 11.
handoff.required_for_reopen: A pinned learned provider that emits descriptors plus license/weight SHA/sidecar contract and a Rust adapter test that submits the payload through the unchanged geometry gate.
do_not_do: do not select the learned provider as a production fallback
do not treat candidate inliers as Stack_Report or QG evidence
